sections.heading: Darkness Below
sections.body: The undercroft has no light but what the party brings, the goblins' fire in [[L1 area 2]] and the furnace in [[L1 area 4]]. Goblins, bugbears, skeletons and the warden all see in the dark ([[vision-and-light]]). Count the lanterns.

sections.heading: When the Bell Tolls
sections.body: If the clapper is hung back in the bell and the bell is rung, every creature in the undercroft hears it. The [[bell-warden]] stops whatever it is doing, returns to its plinth and sleeps, and the ringers in [[L1 area 5]] lie down and do not rise again. The bugbears and goblins are not affected, but they know what the sound means.

sections.heading: Resting in the Undercroft
sections.body: A short rest on the landing or in the vestry is safe unless the goblins have been roused. A long rest below is not: check for a wandering encounter at midnight and again at dawn. Old Hobb will let the party sleep in the chapel pews above, which are safe.
